summary: design-rubric(scope: scenario) 채점 완료: scores={goal:2, adoption:2, boundary:2}, average=2.0, gaps 0건

scoring_reasons.goal: S-9 checks the goal (AC-1, AC-6) directly at the user/operations layer. It restarts task 162 in Codex on the installed build and requires 'codex-start ok, lease·registry owner가 동일한 자식 ID'. S-10 checks the first checkpoint path in a real Codex sandbox.
scoring_reasons.adoption: The goal has a replacement part (AC-5: move installs off the old default argv). S-7 checks both sides: '신규·구 기본은 `--no-daemon`' covers adoption, and '수정 argv는 바이트 보존' covers what must be kept. S-1 and S-6 also check that owner-less success is gone, both before and after the change ('owner_lease_unresolved', 'registry 바이트 불변').
scoring_reasons.boundary: S-1 to S-6 and S-8 check failure and edge paths directly: pending, expired and absent leases; owner mismatch; concurrent owner change; failed close; failed lease re-read; Orca stale/list ambiguity giving unknown; a recover call before checks are done; EPERM/EACCES/EROFS errors; an unsupported Codex argument. AC-3's ban on starting a new child is also checked ('재기동 차단', S-5 '상태 불변').
